latestAction.text: Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.

summary.text: This resolution provides for the consideration of H.R. 2913, the Ukraine Support Act. It also provides that the Clerk of the House shall transmit to the Senate a message that the House has passed H.R. 2913 no later than one week after the bill's passage.

title: Providing for consideration of the bill (H.R. 2913) to authorize support for Ukraine, and for other purposes.
